meta.name: brandkit
meta.description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.

copy.tagline: 生成高端品牌视觉指南与标识系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建品牌指南或标识系统
copy.tagline_en: Generate premium brand visual guidelines and identity systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create brand guidelines or identity systems

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成高端品牌形象板，包括标志系统、品牌指南和视觉世界展示。它根据品牌策略设计极简、电影感或科技风格的图像，输出专业级品牌套件。
howto.when: 当你要求创建品牌形象板、标志系统或品牌指南时触发。例如，描述一个品牌（如开发者工具、安全产品）并指定风格或布局。

say.text: 为我的AI助手品牌设计一个品牌形象板。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个3x3的品牌套件图像。

say.text: 为一个安全产品创建2x3的品牌指南板。
say.note: Claude 会输出一个2x3的参考风格板。

say.text: 为一个奢侈时尚品牌设计标志和色彩系统。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含标志、色彩和应用的板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates premium brand-kit images including logo systems, brand guidelines boards, and visual-world presentations. It designs minimalist, cinematic, or tech-style images based on brand strategy, outputting professional-grade brand decks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a brand board, logo system, or brand guidelines. For example, describe a brand (e.g., developer tool, security product) and specify style or layout.

say_en.text: Design a brand kit board for my AI assistant product.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a 3x3 brand kit image.

say_en.text: Create a 2x3 brand guidelines board for a security tool.
say_en.note: Claude will output a 2x3 reference-style board.

say_en.text: Design a logo and color system for a luxury fashion brand.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a board with logo, colors, and applications.
